items.title_en: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, world’s top court rules
items.title_zh: 世界最高法院裁定緬甸對羅興亞少數族群犯下種族滅絕罪
items.summary_en: The International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya people in 2017. The court found an intent to destroy a large part of this minority group. This historic decision ends a legal battle that lasted seven years.
items.summary_zh: 國際法院裁定緬甸於 2017 年對羅興亞人犯下種族滅絕罪。法院認定其意圖摧毀該少數族群的大部分人口。這項歷史性裁決結束了長達七年的法律訴訟。
items.why_important_en: This is a historic ruling because the court has never held a state responsible for genocide before. It sets a critical standard for international human rights law.
items.why_important_zh: 這是一項歷史性判決，因為該法院此前從未認定任何國家須對種族滅絕負責。這為國際人權法樹立了重要標竿。

vocab.definition_en: an official decision made by a court or a judge
vocab.sentence_en: We must trust our manager to make the final judgment on this project.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我們必須信任經理會對這個專案做出最終決定。

vocab.definition_en: large in amount, size, or importance
vocab.sentence_en: The company offered him a substantial raise after his successful presentation.
vocab.sentence_zh: 在他成功簡報後，公司給了他大幅的加薪。

vocab.definition_en: extremely important or serious
vocab.sentence_en: Good communication is critical for the success of any small team.
vocab.sentence_zh: 良好的溝通對於任何小型團隊的成功都是至關重要的。

vocab.definition_en: a choice or judgment that you make after thinking
vocab.sentence_en: Please let me know your decision about the new contract by Friday.
vocab.sentence_zh: 請在星期五前告訴我您對新合約的決定。

items.title_en: California targets Nvidia in China AI chip probe
items.title_zh: 加州針對輝達在中國的人工智慧晶片展開調查
items.summary_en: The state of California is investigating the AI chipmaker Nvidia. California is the location of Nvidia's global headquarters. This probe started after the former CEO Jensen Huang left his position.
items.summary_zh: 加利福尼亞州正在調查人工智慧晶片製造商輝達。加州是輝達全球總部的所在地。這項調查是在前執行長黃仁勳離職後展開的。
items.why_important_en: Nvidia is a key leader in global AI technology. Government investigations could impact the tech industry and global chip business.
items.why_important_zh: 輝達是全球人工智慧技術的關鍵領導者。政府的調查可能會影響科技產業及全球晶片業務。

vocab.definition_en: to aim an action, product, or plan at a particular person or group
vocab.sentence_en: The new marketing campaign will target young people who love online shopping.
vocab.sentence_zh: 新的行銷活動將鎖定喜愛網路購物的年輕人。

vocab.definition_en: a careful and thorough examination or official investigation
vocab.sentence_en: The police launched a thorough probe into the company's financial records.
vocab.sentence_zh: 警方對該公司的財務記錄展開了全面調查。

vocab.definition_en: the main office or center of an organization or business
vocab.sentence_en: Our head office is in Tokyo, but we also have a branch in Taipei.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我們的總部在東京，但我們在台北也有分公司。

vocab.definition_en: the act of leaving a job, organization, or place
vocab.sentence_en: His sudden departure from the company surprised everyone in the office.
vocab.sentence_zh: 他突然從公司離職讓辦公室的所有人都感到驚訝。

items.title_en: Fiona the hippo dies after ingesting knitted hat at Cincinnati zoo
items.title_zh: 辛辛那提動物園河馬費歐娜誤吞針織帽後不幸死亡
items.summary_en: Fiona, a very famous hippo in an American zoo, has died. She swallowed a knitted hat that fell into her area, and vets could not remove it. The zoo announced this sad news and called it a medical emergency.
items.summary_zh: 美國一所動物園中極具名氣的河馬費歐娜已不幸死亡。她吞下了一頂掉入展區的針織帽，獸醫未能成功將其取出。動物園公布了這個悲痛的消息，並稱這是一起醫療緊急事件。
items.why_important_en: Fiona was a beloved animal with a large global fan base. This incident highlights the safety risks that human objects cause to zoo animals.
items.why_important_zh: 費歐娜是一隻深受全球喜愛的明星動物。這起事件凸顯了人類物品對動物園動物所造成的安全風險。

vocab.definition_en: an attempt to do something difficult
vocab.sentence_en: She put a lot of effort into preparing for her job interview.
vocab.sentence_zh: 她投入了大量努力來準備她的求職面試。

vocab.definition_en: to take something away or off from a place
vocab.sentence_en: Please remove your shoes before you enter the traditional Japanese restaurant.
vocab.sentence_zh: 進入這家傳統日本餐廳前，請先脫下鞋子。

vocab.definition_en: an act of trying to do something
vocab.sentence_en: He passed the driving test on his first attempt yesterday.
vocab.sentence_zh: 他昨天第一次嘗試就通過了駕照考試。

vocab.definition_en: a sudden, serious situation that needs immediate action
vocab.sentence_en: In case of emergency, please leave the building through the nearest exit.
vocab.sentence_zh: 發生緊急狀況時，請經由最近的出口離開建築物。

items.title_en: What is at stake at the EU-UK summit in Brussels?
items.title_zh: 在布魯塞爾舉行的歐盟—英國峰會有哪些重要議題？
items.summary_en: The European Union and the United Kingdom will hold a major meeting in Brussels. Leaders want to discuss their long-term relationship, including rules and youth mobility. Key politicians like the UK prime minister will attend the summit.
items.summary_zh: 歐洲聯盟與英國將在布魯塞爾舉行一場重大會議。領導人希望討論包括規定和青年交流在內的長期關係。英國首相等重要政治人物將出席這場峰會。
items.why_important_en: This meeting can reshape post-Brexit cooperation between the UK and the European Union. It directly affects trade rules, work opportunities, and travel.
items.why_important_zh: 這場會議可能會重塑英國與歐盟在脫歐後的合作關係。這將直接影響貿易法規、工作機會和旅遊。

vocab.definition_en: an important formal meeting between leaders of governments
vocab.sentence_en: The managers will attend the annual sales summit in Singapore next week.
vocab.sentence_zh: 經理們下週將出席在新加坡舉辦的年度銷售高峰會。

vocab.definition_en: to make something less difficult, strict, or painful
vocab.sentence_en: Taking a short walk during lunch can help ease your workday stress.
vocab.sentence_zh: 午餐時間散步一下可以幫助減輕你的工作壓力。

vocab.definition_en: to bring something back to an earlier good condition or position
vocab.sentence_en: The technical support team quickly worked to restore our internet connection.
vocab.sentence_zh: 技術支援團隊迅速搶修，恢復了我們的網路連線。

vocab.definition_en: to go to or be present at an event, meeting, or class
vocab.sentence_en: All team members must attend the morning training session on Monday.
vocab.sentence_zh: 所有團隊成員週一都必須參加早上的培訓課程。

items.title_en: How did Anthropic's stock market debut unfold?
items.title_zh: Anthropic 首次公開上市的表現如何？
items.summary_en: The artificial intelligence company Anthropic made its debut on the stock market. A BBC report explains what happened on its first day as a public company. The company had a strong start, with its shares closing up by 17%.
items.summary_zh: 人工智慧公司 Anthropic 正式登陸股票市場。英國廣播公司（BBC）報導解析了其作為上市公司的首日表現。該公司迎來了強勁開局，股價收盤上漲 17%。
items.why_important_en: This stock debut shows strong investor confidence in the generative AI industry. The market's reaction can influence future tech investments.
items.why_important_zh: 這次上市展示了投資人對生成式人工智慧產業的強烈信心。市場的反響可能會影響未來的科技投資動向。

vocab.definition_en: the first public appearance or launch of a product, company, or person
vocab.sentence_en: The new smartphone made its official debut at the electronics show.
vocab.sentence_zh: 這款新智慧型手機在電子展上正式亮相。

vocab.definition_en: to develop or become known over time
vocab.sentence_en: We watched the exciting football game unfold on the big TV screen.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我們在大電視螢幕上看著刺激的足球比賽進行。

vocab.definition_en: one of the equal parts into which a company's total capital is divided
vocab.sentence_en: She decided to buy some shares in a popular coffee shop chain.
vocab.sentence_zh: 她決定買進一些這家知名連鎖咖啡店的股票。

vocab.definition_en: to separate information into parts to make it easier to understand
vocab.sentence_en: Could you please break down the budget numbers for this quarter?
vocab.sentence_zh: 你能為大家詳細拆解分析一下這一季的預算數字嗎？
